WITH siparis_kalemleri_agregeli AS (
    SELECT 
        urun_id,
        SUM(adet) AS toplam_satin_alinan_adet,
        SUM(birim_fiyat * adet) AS toplam_ciro
    FROM siparis_kalemleri
    GROUP BY urun_id
),
iadeler_agregeli AS (
    SELECT 
        urun_id,
        SUM(adet) AS toplam_iade_eden_adet,
        SUM(birim_fiyat * adet) AS toplam_iade_ciro
    FROM iadeler
    GROUP BY urun_id
),
net_hesaplama AS (
    SELECT 
        u.id AS urun_id,
        u.ad AS urun_ad,
        COALESCE(ka.toplam_satin_alinan_adet, 0) - COALESCE(ia.toplam_iade_eden_adet, 0) AS net_adet,
        COALESCE(ka.toplam_ciro, 0) - COALESCE(ia.toplam_iade_ciro, 0) AS net_ciro
    FROM urunler u
    LEFT JOIN siparis_kalemleri_agregeli ka ON u.id = ka.urun_id
    LEFT JOIN iadeler_agregeli ia ON u.id = ia.urun_id
),
siralama AS (
    SELECT 
        urun_ad,
        net_adet,
        net_ciro,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_ciro DESC, urun_ad ASC) AS sirasi
    FROM net_hesaplama
)
SELECT 
    urun_ad,
    net_adet,
    ROUND(net_ciro, 2) AS net_ciro
FROM siralama
WHERE sirasi <= 5
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC, urun_ad ASC;
